title: Company Overview
content: NurIA Labs is an innovative technology startup specializing in Artificial Intelligence solutions for enterprises, with a strong focus on responsible AI use. Our flagship product is GESCON, an enterprise platform that allows companies to manage internal knowledge and deploy intelligent AI agents connected to their own data sources. Our client engagement methodology consists of three main steps: Diagnosis (understanding bottlenecks), Pilot (controlled environment validation), and Deployment (industrialization and training).

title: Partners and Leadership
content: NurIA Labs is led by a core team of AI experts and founders: Elena Martínez (CEO), Carlos Ruiz (CTO & Head of AI), Ana Beltrán (COO), Jorge Navarro (CFO), and Laura Chen (VP of Engineering). The leadership team meets weekly on Tuesdays at 10:00 AM CET. Strategic decisions regarding the GESCON platform roadmap and new AI model integrations require approval from at least 3 of the 5 partners.

title: Employee Count and Teams
content: As of 2026, NurIA Labs has a growing team of 48 employees distributed across specialized areas: AI & Data Engineering (18 people), GESCON Platform Development (12 people), Product & Design (6 people), Sales & Partnerships (6 people), Customer Success (4 people), and Operations/HR (2 people). The team works closely to integrate the latest LLMs into our enterprise solutions.

title: Onboarding Process
content: New employees go through a 2-week onboarding process. Week 1 includes: equipment setup, account creation (email, Slack, GitHub, Jira, and administrative access to GESCON), HR paperwork, mandatory AI Ethics & Security training, and a welcome lunch. Week 2 includes: introduction to the GESCON architecture, pair programming with a buddy, and a first small task (e.g., adding a feature to a GESCON agent). Each new hire is assigned a dedicated onboarding buddy.

title: How to Open a Jira Ticket
content: To create a new Jira ticket: 1) Go to jira.nurialabs.internal and log in. 2) Select the appropriate project board (GESCON-CORE for platform, AI-MODELS for LLM integrations, OPS for infrastructure). 3) Click 'Create Issue' and choose: Bug, Story, Task, or Epic. 4) Fill in Summary, Description, Priority (P1-Critical to P4-Low). 5) For GESCON bugs, always include: steps to reproduce, expected AI agent behavior, actual AI agent response, and the specific LLM model used (e.g., GPT-4o, Claude 3.5).

title: Vacation and Time-Off Policy
content: All full-time employees receive 23 paid vacation days per year, plus national and regional holidays. Vacation requests must be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance through BambooHR. Team leads must approve requests within 3 business days. No more than 30% of a team can be on vacation simultaneously. Unused vacation days can be carried over (maximum 5 days) to Q1 of the following year. Sick leave requires a medical certificate if it exceeds 3 consecutive days.

title: Incident Management Process
content: Incidents are classified by severity. SEV1 (GESCON platform down, API integrations failing for all clients - response within 15 mins), SEV2 (Specific AI agent or data source sync broken - response within 1 hour), SEV3 (Minor UI issue in GESCON - response within 4 hours). For SEV1/SEV2: notify the on-call engineer via PagerDuty, create a Slack channel (#incident-YYYY-MM-DD), start a Google Meet war room. Post-incident reviews are mandatory for SEV1/SEV2 to prevent future AI hallucination or downtime issues.

title: Internal Tools and Platforms
content: NurIA Labs uses the following internal tools: Communication - Slack, Google Meet. Internal Knowledge - We use our own GESCON platform configured with internal company data for HR and IT queries. Project Management - Jira, Notion. Code - GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions. Infrastructure - AWS, Vercel, Datadog (monitoring), PagerDuty. Support - soporte@nurialabs.com for client ticketing. All tools are accessible via company SSO.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: NurIA Labs operates with a flexible hybrid work model. Employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week. Tuesday and Thursday are our recommended in-office days for architecture whiteboard sessions and team collaboration. Remote workers must be available during core hours (10:00 AM - 4:00 PM CET). Home office equipment stipend: 500 EUR one-time setup allowance for new employees to ensure a proper remote workstation.

title: Code Review and Deployment Process
content: All code changes to the GESCON platform require a pull request with at least 1 approval. PRs must pass all CI checks (tests, linting, security). If the PR modifies AI prompts or model parameters, it must also pass the automated 'Prompt Evaluation' suite to ensure response quality and prevent regressions. Deployments to staging happen automatically on merge to main. Production deployments are triggered manually through GitHub Actions. Rollback procedures must be documented for every release.
